The fairy cory, Hoplisoma atropersonatum, long known as Corydoras atropersonatus, is an armoured catfish known only from the Tigre and Nanay drainages in Ecuador and Peru.
Type locality: Río Conambo at mouth of River Shione, Río Tigre system, Pastaza State, Ecuador.
It looks very similar to Corydoras atropersonatus, which also comes from Peru (Rio Nanay basin), but is even more attractive.
Corydoras atropersonatus was described from specimens from Ecuador (Rio Tigre basin).
